profile.headline: Computer Vision & Embedded Systems Expert | ex-Samsung | PhD in ECE
profile.summary:
I am a results-driven AI Software Engineer with a strong background in computer vision, deep learning, and embedded systems. With a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering and years of hands-on experience, I have successfully delivered real-time perception systems for applications ranging from intelligent transportation to robotics and XR devices.

Having contributed to startups and research-driven teams alike, I bring a balance of deep technical insight and practical deployment experience. I'm passionate about pushing the boundaries of on-device AI and collaborating across disciplines to solve complex engineering challenges.

positions.title: Sr. AI Software Engineer / Lead
positions.description:
• Led development of a deep learning-based driver eye-position tracking pipeline (C++/OpenCV) to build in-vehicle 3D Head-Up Display
• Designed a lightweight deep learning model (Python/PyTorch/ONNX/TensorRT) with attention mechanisms to enable accurate eye position detection on constrained devices (Nvidia Jetson)
• Performed data collection and pre-processing workflows to ensure robustness in real-world driving conditions
• Defined product design and specifications through testing and verification for mass production of automobiles
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Vision · Deep Learning · C++ · Python · Pytorch · Linux · ONNX · TensorRT

positions.title: Product Owner (Lead Software Engineer)
positions.description:
• Led development of LiDAR-based 3D perception software (C) using deep learning and conventional approaches
• Delivered 30+ embedded (Nvidia Jetson) solutions for Intelligent Transportation Systems and security
• Spearheaded code optimization resulted in latency reduce by more than 30%
• Worked closely with clients and stakeholders to customize solutions, ensuring successful delivery of LiDAR-based systems in diverse environments
positions.insights: Skills: Product Development · LiDAR · Computer Vision · Computer Science · Software Development · C++ · Perception · C
